fonts.display: 'Soehne', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Soehne', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, hairline dividers between sections, ghost-button borders — the lightest structural gray carries borders, surface, and the dominant background in a near-white mode

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Primary body and heading text, nav links, footer text, filled button text — near-black for maximum legibility without the harshness of pure black

palette.name: Paper
palette.role: Card surfaces, filled button backgrounds, image overlays, reverse text on dark sections — the brightest structural white

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Headings on light canvas where maximum contrast is required, nav background accents — used sparingly only where absolute black is needed

palette.name: Deep Current
palette.role: Dark feature section backgrounds (alternating bands), large image containers — the navy-black that recedes like deep ocean water

palette.name: Slate Depth
palette.role: Secondary dark section background, elevated panels over Deep Current — one step lighter to layer depth within dark bands
